# [STORY] As a maintainer, I want the issue templates and audit tooling kept correct, so that every audit applies one fixed standard

## User Story
**As a** maintainer
**I want** the four issue templates and the audit tooling kept correct
**So that** every audit under this epic applies one fixed standard instead of a moving one

## Acceptance Criteria (Given/When/Then)
- [ ] Given the four templates, when a new issue is opened from any of them,
      then each acceptance criterion must name the test or command that proves
      it, and a date is stated not to be a proof
- [ ] Given the templates, when they are read, then no section duplicates a
      GitHub feature: no child list, no `Parent: #N` line, no `## Sprint`
- [ ] Given the templates, when they are read, then the label rule is stated:
      one type label, one priority label, `sprint-N` retired
- [ ] Given the 39 stories that still carry `## Sprint`, when the template
      drops it, then the section is removed from them too
- [ ] Given `.claude/skills/audit-artifacts/`, when an audit runs, then the
      skill and the writing standard match the templates they enforce

## Definition of Ready
- [ ] Meets [Definition of Ready](https://github.com/liviuionesi/lmdb.dev/blob/develop/docs/process/DEFINITION_OF_READY.md)

## Story Points
**Estimate:** 5

## Definition of Done
- [ ] Meets [Definition of Done](https://github.com/liviuionesi/lmdb.dev/blob/develop/docs/process/DEFINITION_OF_DONE.md)

## Notes
This story is the standard the other 12 stories under #251 audit against. It
stays open for the life of the epic: a template or skill change found mid-audit
lands here, not in the story that happened to find it.
